- Identify whether document is an invoice: presence of "RECHNUNG", totals, VAT—yes.
- Locate fields required by schema and avoid guessing.

Extraction paths and decisions:
1) GrandTotal.Amount
- Found "Endbetrag EUR 460,01". Clear total payable. Extract as numeric 460.01.

2) Invoice.Date
- Candidate dates: "Ihr Auftrag: 32401072 vom: 25-01-2024" (order date) and "Wien am 26-01-2024" (document issue line). The invoice issue date is taken as "Wien am 26-01-2024". Extract "26-01-2024" as string.

3) Sender.VatId
- Two UIDs present: "Ihre UID: ATU22642807" (customer UID) and "UID-Nr.: ATU 43349701" near company info. Sender is SENNA; use sender UID "ATU43349701" (remove space).

4) Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount
- VAT group shows "+ 10 % Mehrwertsteuer 41,82" and "Auftragssumme 418,19" above. Interpret:
  - Net.Amount = 418,19 -> 418.19
  - Vat.Rate = 10 (drop %)
  - Vat.Amount = 41,82 -> 41.82

Verification and alternatives considered:
- Alternative VAT rates present nowhere else; VTR numbers not VAT percent. Chosen 10% is explicitly stated.
- Net and VAT amounts correspond: 418.19 + 41.82 = 460.01 matching Endbetrag.
- Invoice date choice favors document issue ("Wien am 26-01-2024") over order "vom 25-01-2024".

No fields were inferred beyond explicit text.
